annotations.title: What vet402 saw when it paid this x402 URL

description: Look up vet402's published purchase record for one x402 URL. Read-only. It does not pay. Pass url: the absolute https x402 URL. check_x402_seller shows what happened when vet402 paid an x402 URL: whether the payment settled, whether content came back, and the transaction where vet402 recorded one. For WARN or BLOCK, read reason_codes. verified_terms holds the payTo, amount and network of the last purchase where content came back, so they can be set against the terms of a 402 response. Its amount is in 6-decimal ledger units: multiply it by 10^12 on BNB Chain and by 10 on Stellar before comparing it with a 402. verified_pay_to_by_network lists each payTo vet402 paid and saw content come back from, per network. If the network and payTo of a 402 response are not in that list, vet402 has not checked that payTo on that network. When method is left out, GET is looked up first and then POST. A URL that vet402 has no record of comes back with not_in_catalog set to true, up to five other listings on the same host, the catalogs vet402 reads, and diagnose_url for a live 402 read. Use it to look up the vet402 purchase record of one URL. For the 402 response as it is now, open diagnose_url. To search for sellers, use find_x402_sellers. For a host you run, use check_my_x402_endpoint. evidence_age comes first and states the date and age of the last delivery from a paid test, and an answer can be no better than WARN when that delivery is older than 30 days or there is none, unless the caller passed allow_without_l1. reasons holds one English sentence per reason code, its effect on the answer, and references to purchases, transactions or response hashes when the record names them, with evidence_status none when nothing in the record can be pointed to. It changes no data, needs no API key and has no charge. Up to 120 calls per minute per IP. Verdicts and reason codes are documented at https://vet402.com/docs/api#verdicts.

method.description: The HTTP method of the listing, such as GET or POST. Leave it out to look up GET first and then POST.

url.description: The x402 URL, as an absolute https URL of up to 2048 characters.

name: check_x402_seller

verified_pay_to_by_network.description: Recipients vet402 paid and confirmed delivery to, per chain (latest per network and pay_to, newest first, at most 10). If the network and payTo pair of the 402 you received is not here, vet402 has not verified the recipient on that network.

pay_to.description: 0x addresses lowercase; other chains as recorded.

amount.description: 6-decimal ledger units, not always the asset's own base units: multiply by 10^12 on BNB Chain and by 10 on Stellar before comparing with a 402.

decimals.description: The decimals of amount in the ledger, not of the asset.
